description: Capabilities for the tablet / mobile app (M-1: narrowed from wildcard). The four dialog/fs grants added 2026-09-20 by the tablet file-picker slice are deliberately command-scoped rather than dialog:default / fs:default, keeping the M-1 narrowing intact; no fs:scope entry is granted because the mobile resolve_file Url arm does not consult the scope for a content:// URI (tauri-plugin-fs commands.rs:1448-1477), so a scope entry would read like enforcement without being any.
